message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick guide on how to fetch the latest comments for **microsoft.com** using your `gamma_key` and limiting the results to 20 entries.

---

### 1. Using cURL (Command Line)

```bash
curl -X GET \
     "https://api.example.com/v1/comments?domain=microsoft.com&limit=20" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer gamma_key"
```

> **What this does:**  
> • Sends a GET request to the `/v1/comments` endpoint.  
> • Passes the domain (`microsoft.com`) and the maximum number of records (`20`).  
> • Uses the `Authorization` header to authenticate with your API key.

---

### 2. Using Python (Requests Library)

```python
import requests

url = "https://api.example.com/v1/comments"
params = {
    "domain": "microsoft.com",
    "limit": 20
}
headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer gamma_key"
}

response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    # `data` will contain the list of comment objects
    print(data)
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
```

> **What this does:**  
> • Builds the query parameters (`domain`, `limit`).  
> • Adds the bearer token to the request header.  
> • Parses the JSON response into a Python dictionary/list.

---

### 3. Using JavaScript (Fetch API)

```javascript
const url = new URL('https://api.example.com/v1/comments');
url.searchParams.append('domain', 'microsoft.com');
url.searchParams.append('limit', '20');

fetch(url, {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer gamma_key'
  }
})
.then(response => {
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
  return response.json();
})
.then(data => console.log(data))
.catch(err => console.error(err));
```

---

#### Quick Checklist

| ✅ | Item |
|---|------|
| ✅ | Replace `https://api.example.com/v1/comments` with the actual base URL of your service. |
| ✅ | Ensure your key (`gamma_key`) is valid and has permission to read comments. |
| ✅ | Adjust the `limit` parameter if you need more or fewer results. |
